name: Gasthaus Krämerwirt
kurzbeschreibung: Gasthaus Krämerwirt in the hamlet of Kleinsöll in Breitenbach am Inn near Kufstein – regional cuisine and pizza.
beschreibung: The Gasthaus Krämerwirt is located in the hamlet of Kleinsöll in the municipality of Breitenbach am Inn, in the Tyrolean district of Kufstein. The establishment is run as an inn serving regional cuisine; the menu includes local dishes as well as pizza. Its location in the Inn Valley, between the foothills of the Alps and the Tyrolean mountains, makes it a rural place to stop for refreshments in the surroundings of Kundl, Wörgl and the fortress town of Kufstein. Such a village inn stands for down-to-earth Tyrolean hospitality and an easy-going atmosphere away from the major tourist resorts. Here guests enjoy being close to nature and short distances to the surrounding villages of the Inn Valley.
